name: COPPA Children's Privacy Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA, 16 CFR Part 312), covering verifiable parental consent (VPC), age gating, children's PII deletion, and third-party ad tracker blocking.

items.statement: Neutral age-gating mechanism prevents users under 13 from circumventing age entry.
Verifiable Parental Consent (VPC) is obtained prior to collecting any child PII (name, email, geolocation, voice/photo).
Direct notice to parents clearly explains data collection practices, retention, and deletion rights (§312.4).
Behavioral advertising, re-targeting pixels, and persistent identifier tracking are disabled for child accounts (§312.8).
Parents are provided continuous access to review and request deletion of their child's PII (§312.6).

reviewGates.name: COPPA Children's Privacy Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Privacy Officer confirms that age gating, VPC verification, and ad tracker blocking meet COPPA requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the privacy audit evidence confirm full COPPA compliance for child user data?
